name: gated-development-orchestration
description: Coordinate human-verifiable checkpoint development through role-scoped rounds, Evidence Admission, durable proof history, repeated-blocker economy, bounded method development, mechanical correction, and independent review.

interface.longDescription: GDO 4.7.3 preserves the v3 lifecycle and prior readiness safeguards while adding owner-aware Evidence Admission continuation: Implementation-owned rejection returns to the same round, infrastructure rejection remains non-round, and TRIAGE_REQUIRED routes to Governance Triage.
defaultPrompt: Load the GDO workflow core and only the active role skill.
Perform the authorized GDO round using current GitHub authority and current actor authority.
For new product-code Evidence handoffs, use the opt-in Evidence Admission marker and committed gdo-proof-ledger/v1 contract; admission is control-plane readiness, never acceptance proof.

Treat Evidence Admission as a non-round owner-aware gate: implementation-owned NOT_READY resumes the same Implementation round; infrastructure-owned NOT_READY creates no lifecycle round; TRIAGE_REQUIRED routes Governance Triage.

For CP2 proof-history-enabled campaigns, respect the deterministic Evidence re-entry guard: repeated same-proof verification-method blockers require durable METHOD READY feedback or an explicit bounded human override before another formal Evidence round.
Use targeted development checks or Discovery Probes for bounded verification-method development; method readiness is development feedback only and cannot satisfy Evidence proof.

Before dispatching a Discovery Probe, establish that its apparatus can reach the material observation with no known setup blocker; keep build/package/deployment/fixture/transport repair inside Discovery and never use successive probes as a build/debug loop.

Before activating Implementation, confirm the checkpoint is one coherent engineering/product claim that can reasonably converge to one evidence-ready candidate; split multiple independently reviewable product states instead of overloading one round.

Before dispatching a targeted development check, ensure no known unrelated harness/transport/fixture/environment/setup blocker prevents the intended candidate observation; repair apparatus inside Implementation rather than using successive checks as a debug loop.
Inside active Evidence, correct only frozen-allowlist mechanical invocation mistakes with original-attempt preservation; never weaken acceptance or retry until green.
Keep lifecycle comments delta-oriented: compress duplicated authority/raw detail, never provenance, correction boundary, proof disposition, or machine routing fields.
Preserve v3 lifecycle markers, worker separation, actor-takeover semantics, and sole Independent Review PASS authority.
